newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BARMBY HEADS LATE EVERTON WINNER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARMBY HEADS LATE EVERTON WINNER.

text.p: England forward Nick Barmby headed a late goal to give Everton a 1-0 English premier league win at Derby on Monday.
Barmby reacted quickly to score from point blank range in the 86th minute after midfielder Joe Parkinson's 25-metre effort had rebounded off the crossbar.
Everton's victory lifted them into seventh place, eight points behind leaders Arsenal.
Derby were left to rue their missed chances, most notably a header by forward Ashley Ward which flashed just over the bar midway through the second half.
